Latin word

crēscō

crēscō, crēscere, crēvī, crētum

verb, third conjugation, intransitive · Conjugation on Wiktionary

grow; grow, get bigger; increase, grow

In this lexicon

  • develop

    also used · classical · Liv. 1.8.4: crēscēbat interim urbs

  • grow

    the recommended word · classical · Quint. 1.2.7: in lectīcīs crēscunt; Ov. Met. 2.643: crēsce, puer (Lewis & Short)

  • increase

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 3.26.4: crēvit ex metū aliēnō, ut fit, audācia; Plin. Ep. 9.33.6: crēscit audācia experīmentō

Examples

  • Puer autem crēscēbat, et cōnfortābātur plēnus sapientiā

    And the child grew, and grew strong, filled with wisdomVulg. Lc. 2.40

    it has been found that if young boys eat too much and sleep too long, … their bodies stay short and grow lessVarro in Gell. 4.19.1
